name: capability-gated-prompt-fragments
description: Capability-gated prompt fragments (warren-cb46): builtin agents carry tracker/mulch text in AgentDefinition.gatedPrompts; spawnRun composes sections.system against resolvePromptCapabilities (project.hasSeeds + tracker.capabilities.isGitNative for seeds, fresh detectProjectFeatures probe for .mulch) and strips gatedPrompts so frozen rendered_agent_json matches what the run saw. Quality-gate prompt text is stack-neutral: $WARREN_QUALITY_GATE → AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md → discover project's own commands, never a bare bun run check:all.

name: warren-dispatch-intent-before-io
description: WarrenDispatcher: journal deterministic dispatch action + full-cap budget reservation in one SQLite transaction before any I/O; action key doubles as the Idempotency-Key; ambiguous POST with no correlated run settles uncertain, creates attention, and is never re-POSTed; restart reconciles known runs via authoritative GETs and fails closed for unknown ones; unknown terminal cost keeps the reservation conservative
